items.description: WhatProblem is a GitHub app that reads newly opened issues, restates the problem, and asks clarifying questions in the issue thread within a minute or two; clear issues get only the restatement; nothing to run or configure
Works only through GitHub issue comments; never touches pull requests and skips issues opened by bots
Billing: one issue costs one unit of the monthly allowance regardless of rounds; follow-ups and closing summary not charged; 10% grace band above the limit
Commands are `!whatproblem analyze` and `!whatproblem stop`, commented on an issue; stop applies to that issue only and is undone with analyze
Conversations run at most five rounds; no timers — a thread quiet for over a week gets a short note instead of a new round, resumed with `!whatproblem analyze`
Beta allowance is 150 clarified issues a month for the first 100 installations
Billing is via GitHub Marketplace, so refunds and cancellations are handled by GitHub, not WhatProblem
Support: general questions on the public GitHub tracker, account-specific issues to support@whatproblem.dev; operated by Williams Initiatives Ltd (UK company 14929985)
How it works: what the bot does and when it stays quiet
Commands reference: every command and what stopping applies to
Plans and limits: pricing/allowance and what counts against it
Troubleshooting doc on GitHub for when the bot did not respond
Undated reference guides on writing bug reports, feature requests, reproduction steps, issue titles, and triaging issues
Blog posts on issue clarity, triage, GitHub webhooks/bots, and bug reporting
Audience pages explaining the case for different roles (maintainers, product teams, QA, engineering managers, developers)
